rows.name: statement_b_distinctness
rows.statement:
theorem statement_b_distinctness (S : IDSSystem) (stage : Fin 4) :
    ∀ C₁ C₂ : S.MechClass stage,
      S.identityOf stage C₁ = S.identityOf stage C₂ → C₁ = C₂

rows.name: T3prime_shared_witness
rows.statement:
theorem T3prime_shared_witness
    (𝒞 : Set Coupling) (s : ℂ)
    (h1 : ∀ C ∈ 𝒞, C Phi)
    (h2 : mellin Phi (s / 2) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℂ, (∀ C ∈ 𝒞, C Φ) ∧ mellin Φ (s / 2) ≠ 0
rows.hypotheses: h1 : every coupling of the family satisfied by T1`s Phi (the shared witness, Determination`s supply) ; h2 : mellin Phi (s / 2) ≠ 0
rows.grade: DERIVES (thin) -- existential introduction ⟨Phi, h1, h2⟩; the shared witness is the hypothesis h1, named as such in its docstring

rows.name: T3doubleprime_general_commutation_fails
rows.statement:
theorem T3doubleprime_general_commutation_fails :
    ¬ ∀ (𝒞 : Set Coupling) (s : ℂ),
        (∀ C ∈ 𝒞, ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℂ, C Φ ∧ mellin Φ (s / 2) ≠ 0) →
        ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℂ, (∀ C ∈ 𝒞, C Φ) ∧ mellin Φ (s / 2) ≠ 0
rows.grade: DERIVES -- a countermodel at s = 3: two couplings Φ = f₁ and Φ = f₂ (f₁, f₂ agreeing on Ioi 0, differing at t = -1), each excluding at s through completedRiemannZeta 3 ≠ 0, no Φ satisfying both

rows.name: kappa_zero_of_no_mechanism
rows.statement:
theorem kappa_zero_of_no_mechanism
    {A B : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (P : B -> Real) (f : A -> B) (a0 : A)
    (h_no_mechanism : ∀ a : A, P (f a) = P (f a0)) :
    kappa P f a0 = 0
rows.hypotheses: h_no_mechanism : ∀ a, P (f a) = P (f a0)
rows.grade: DERIVES -- κ computed as the max of a Fintype response set, zero under no response
